Legend key

Source: R/legend.R
legend_key.Rd

One entry of a [bb_legend()].

Usage

legend_key(type, label, color = NULL, state = NULL)

Arguments

type

`"swatch"` (square), `"dot"`, `"diamond"`, `"status"` (a [bb_status()] icon), `"line"` or `"dash"`.

label

Label text.

color

Key colour (theme names allowed). Not needed for `"status"`.

state

Status for `type = "status"`.

Value

A `bb_legend_key` object.

Examples

legend_key("swatch", "<80%", "#C8503F")
#> $type
#> [1] "swatch"
#> 
#> $label
#> [1] "<80%"
#> 
#> $color
#> [1] "#C8503F"
#> 
#> $state
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bb_legend_key"
legend_key("status", "Meets", state = "yes")
#> $type
#> [1] "status"
#> 
#> $label
#> [1] "Meets"
#> 
#> $color
#> NULL
#> 
#> $state
#> [1] "yes"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bb_legend_key"
